features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: The day at a glance: fine totals, pending standups, fines by person, the on-time champion and who is away.

features.title: Daily standup
features.summary: Write today's or the next working day's update, thank a teammate with a shout-out, and see who is in. Your open Jira tickets are attached when you submit.

features.title: Meeting mode
features.summary: The morning sync on one screen: everyone's update with their Jira tickets, who is missing, who is on leave, shout-outs and the word of the meeting.

features.title: Tasks
features.summary: Jira-style issues per project: a board, backlog and sprints, releases, filters, comments and @mentions.

features.title: Team calendar
features.summary: Everyone's meetings, leaves and holidays side by side, read from Google Calendar.

features.title: Late fines
features.summary: Record and settle late fines by season, with the fine fund's collected, withdrawn and remaining totals.

features.title: Standup fines
features.summary: Fines for missed standups, marked paid or pending.

features.title: Leaves
features.summary: Request and track leave, see who is away, and check what is left of each yearly quota.

features.title: Attendance
features.summary: Check in and out at the office, and see the team's attendance by day.

features.title: Planning poker
features.summary: Estimate stories together in a live session, then reveal the votes.

features.title: Retrospective
features.summary: Sprint boards with cards, votes, themes grouped automatically, action items and kudos.

features.title: Word of the day
features.summary: A new word for every meeting, with its meaning.

features.title: Team
features.summary: Everyone on the team, with their details and projects.

features.title: Projects
features.summary: Active and archived projects and who works on them.

features.title: Withdrawals
features.summary: What has been spent from the fine fund.

features.title: Settings
features.summary: Theme, animations and your account; admins also set leave types and quotas.

releases.title: Jira tickets from the tracker, and What's new
notes: Standups sent from the tracker now carry your open Jira tickets into meeting mode, like HeuBot's do. Done and Backlog tickets are left out.
Meeting mode shows where each update came from: Tracker or HeuBot.
Clear on the standup form empties every answer, even after you've submitted.
Meeting mode's ticket list no longer overflows when someone has many tickets.
Hover a bar in Fines by employee to see the paid and unpaid amounts.
Leave left in the Employees list counts personal, sick and festival leave only, not work from home, unpaid or exam leave. Admins choose which types count in Leave settings.
What's new now shows the tracker on a desktop and a phone side by side, every feature on both apps, and these release notes.

releases.title: Search and banners
notes: Search people, fines or tasks from the top bar (Ctrl K).
Holiday and announcement banners on the dashboard.

releases.title: Tasks
notes: Jira-style issues for every project: board, backlog, sprints and releases.
Assignment and @mention emails, and phone notifications on mobile.

releases.title: Retrospective themes, action items and kudos
notes: Retro cards are grouped into themes automatically; the facilitator can rename, move, split or ungroup them.
Turn top-voted cards into action items, and give kudos on the board.
